metadata.description: SurveysAI tools for AI agents: Google Forms, Czech transcription, open-ended response analysis and qualitative interview analysis.

plugins.name: surveysai-google-forms
plugins.description: Create Google Forms in your own Google account from a plain-text survey draft (SurveysAI for Google Forms MCP server, OAuth sign-in).

plugins.name: surveysai-transkripce
plugins.description: Transcribe Czech audio and video with Transkripce (MCP server; needs a TRANSKRIPCE_API_KEY).

plugins.name: surveysai-open-end
plugins.description: Code open-ended survey responses into a category hierarchy with Open-End Response Analyser (MCP server, OAuth sign-in).

plugins.name: surveysai-qualitative-analysis
plugins.description: Analyse interview and focus group transcripts with SurveysAI Qualitative Analysis (MCP server, OAuth sign-in).
